تختارون (form VIII)
# تَخْتَارُونَ (taḵtārūna) /tax.taː.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَارَ (iḵtāra)
# تُخْتَارُونَ (tuḵtārūna) /tux.taː.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَارَ (iḵtāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
